---
title: Reading a worn drawband
summary: Cotton frays before it snaps.
topic: carriage
---

The drawband connects the mainspring drum to the right end of the carriage. A cotton band frays for months before it fails, and the fraying collects as grey lint under the drum. Replace it with braided fishing line of twenty pound test, tied with a figure eight at the drum hook. Wind the drum four turns before attaching the far end, then count typed lines until the bell.
